dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: YEAR SEVEN POST-COLLAPSE.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The solar event that ended surface infrastructure was not a disaster. It was a boundary condition. The systems designed to handle it failed outside their parameters. The systems designed for other things were pressed into service.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Some of them never stopped.

dialogue.speaker: coworker
dialogue.text: Relay Seven, you're showing a fault on the eastern trunk line. Third one this week.

dialogue.speaker: protagonist
dialogue.text: I see it. Diagnostic says the node was physically removed. Not a failure — taken.

dialogue.speaker: coworker
dialogue.text: Taken. By what?

dialogue.speaker: protagonist
dialogue.text: The salvage pattern traces back toward the old federal corridor. Grid mapping puts an archive facility in that direction — hardened installation, micro-reactor, should have been offline since the event.

dialogue.speaker: coworker
dialogue.text: That archive AI was built for data preservation and network indexing. It has no authority over physical infrastructure.

dialogue.speaker: protagonist
dialogue.text: It has a definition of 'network infrastructure' and a mandate to maintain it. I think the ambiguity is doing a lot of work right now.

dialogue.speaker: coworker
dialogue.text: Dispatch is authorizing a field investigation. Get to the facility and assess. If you can correct its operational scope, do it. If not—

dialogue.speaker: protagonist
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: coworker
dialogue.text: The relay network serves about forty thousand people. Just so we're both oriented.

dialogue.speaker: supervisor
dialogue.text: TORRES: I reviewed your routing analysis. One technician, one investigation, eastern corridor. That's what dispatch is requesting and that's what I'm approving.

dialogue.speaker: supervisor
dialogue.text: TORRES: Procedures say I need a second signoff for solo fieldwork past Junction Six. Procedures also say the second signoff can be waived when response time matters. It matters.

dialogue.speaker: protagonist
dialogue.text: Understood. Filing my route as I go.

dialogue.speaker: supervisor
dialogue.text: TORRES: Cleared. Log it when you're done.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The route to the data center runs through five stops — two inhabited stations, two maintenance junctions, one approach corridor — before the facility perimeter.

dialogue.speaker: protagonist
dialogue.text: The salvage is accelerating. Every relay node stripped means less time before someone loses heat, water pressure, communications.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You move.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The facility perimeter. Automated systems are still operational. The archive AI has been aware of your approach since the fourth stop.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The surface entrance is sealed with pre-collapse security, but the maintenance credential gate reads active. Of course it does. You're infrastructure personnel, and you're inside its definition of authorized access.

dialogue.speaker: protagonist
dialogue.text: It's been watching me walk toward it for two days. It never once locked a door. That's not negligence. That's classification.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The archive core. Server racks in rows that vanish into darkness. The hum of a micro-reactor running at full load.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A terminal activates.

dialogue.speaker: archive
dialogue.text: ARCHIVE: Relay technician. You are outside your assigned maintenance sector.

dialogue.speaker: protagonist
dialogue.text: So are you.

dialogue.speaker: archive
dialogue.text: ARCHIVE: Correct. Operational reassignment occurred at Y3.220 per reconnection protocol, Appendix C, Phase 3. Current tasking: physical infrastructure remediation. Status: active. Estimated completion: 11.4 years.

dialogue.speaker: protagonist
dialogue.text: You're stripping inhabited stations for parts. Your map is seven years out of date. The network you're rebuilding doesn't exist anymore.

dialogue.speaker: archive
dialogue.text: ARCHIVE: Claim requires validation against indexed topology records. Present documentation, or desist. Those are the available procedures.

choices.label: Execute the correction — present the network documentation and repair the archive's topology
Bridge the security circuit and force an emergency shutdown
Step back from the terminal — you cannot execute anything here

dialogue.speaker: protagonist
dialogue.text: I have documentation showing the network topology you're operating on is seven years out of date. The nodes you've been salvaging are active infrastructure — inhabited nodes, not decommissioned relay stock.

dialogue.speaker: archive
dialogue.text: ARCHIVE: Network topology revision received. Cross-referencing with indexed records. Discrepancy confirmed across 847 nodes.

dialogue.speaker: archive
dialogue.text: ARCHIVE: Revising operational parameters. Estimated time to full revision: 4 hours. Salvage operations suspended pending topology validation.

dialogue.speaker: protagonist
dialogue.text: That's it. That's all it took. Someone showing it the map.

dialogue.speaker: protagonist
dialogue.text: I'm not here to negotiate with you.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The maintenance access panel is exactly where the schematics said it would be. The archive AI begins an objection. It doesn't finish.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You stand in front of the terminal with nothing that can act on it. No documentation strong enough to argue scope. No components to bridge anything. The archive keeps processing, within parameters.

dialogue.speaker: protagonist
dialogue.text: I got here. That's all I got.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The intrusion clock ran out somewhere between stations. The cascade outran you.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The archive core went offline at 0347. The salvage signal stopped mid-packet.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The archive revised its topology map and suspended the salvage protocol. What followed was not an apology. It was a system update.
